project.name: X教练 前端设计稿
project.description: 纯对话微信小程序 MVP 前端视觉与交互设计：聊天主流程、Onboarding、子流程弹窗

intentProfile.routingReason: WeChat mini-program UI mockups, no active Design Library, no restore target, open-ended page creation with multiple persistent chat states and sub-flow sheets.

creativeRecipe.businessTone: health/weight-loss coaching app: trustworthy, companion-like, lightly witty, calm and clean
creativeRecipe.layoutArchetype: mobile chat-first app shell with full-screen conversation and bottom sheets
creativeRecipe.visualSignature: sage green primary (#4E7A5C) for user bubbles and CTAs, soft green-tinted background (#F8FBF9), warm terracotta (#C5733A) for calorie highlights, generous whitespace, rounded message bubbles, minimal chrome
creativeRecipe.avoidOneThing: cluttered dashboards, multiple tab bars, decorative gradients, emoji icons

styleContinuityAnchors: Sage green single primary hue used consistently for user bubbles, active states, and CTA fills
Warm terracotta reserved for calorie-range highlights and budget reminders
Soft green-tinted page surface with white coach bubbles and subtle green hairline separators
Consistent 8px/12px/16px radius scale across bubbles, buttons, sheets, inputs
Single mobile navigation model: no bottom tab bar, only top-right settings icon and chat input bar
Coach avatar is not a design asset; placeholder containers reserved for runtime configuration

Pre-registered page-splash and page-auth-login skeleton nodes
Generated splash screen with brand logo and loading animation
Generated auth login page with welcome guide and WeChat auth button
